title: Regional Sales Rank Stability
scenario: Find regions that have maintained the same sales rank for 3 consecutive months.
tableSchema: monthly_sales (region_id INT, mon INT, rnk INT)
hint: Check if rnk = LAG(rnk, 1) and LAG(rnk, 1) = LAG(rnk, 2).
correctQuery: SELECT region_id FROM (SELECT region_id, mon, rnk, LAG(rnk) OVER(PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY mon) as p1, LAG(rnk, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY mon) as p2 FROM monthly_sales) t WHERE rnk = p1 AND p1 = p2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE monthly_sales (region_id INT, mon INT, rnk INT);
